## Behavior

Describe the concrete change and any scoring, missing-value or provenance impact.

## Validation

- [ ] TypeScript: npm run check
- [ ] Lint: npm run lint
- [ ] Local unit tests: npm test
- [ ] Browser tests: npm run test:ui
- [ ] Production build: npm run build
- [ ] Screenshots for visible UI changes
- [ ] Only local fixtures; no production API, credentials, jobs or deployment

Request team review before merging to main.
